paite: Huan chiamtehna thupi leh lamdang, angel sagih, hii nanung sagih, ananungpente, Pathian hehna toh kidim tawi, van ah ka mu hi.
heading: Angel Sagih Leh Gimna Sagihte
english: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

paite: Huan limlang tuipi hileh kilawm, mei toh kihel leh gamsa leh alim leh amin nambat tung a vualzoute, akhut ua Pathian gosem tawi a, limlang tuipi kiang a dingh ka mu a,
english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, TR adds “his mark,” and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

paite: amau Pathian sikha, Mosi la leh Belamnou la asa uhi. "Na thilhihte thupi in alamdang hi. Aw Toupa Pathian, Bangkim hihthei! Na lampite adik in atang uhi, Misiangthoute Kumpipa, chi in.
english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

paite: Toupa aw, kua'n ahia na min hih thupi a lau lou ding? Nang kia lah siangthou na hi ngal a. Namte tengteng hong pai in na ma ah ahong be ding uh, na thilhih diktatte lah hihlat in omta ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

paite: Hiai thilte ka muh nung in, van a theihsakna biakbuk dantan sungnung hon in a-om a;
english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

paite: huan hiai dantan sungnung a kipan in angel sagih, gawtna sagih nei, puanmalngat siangthou leh vak a kizem a, dangka-eng kawnggak a a-awm ua kigakte ahong paikhia uhi.
english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.

paite: Thil hing lite lak a khat in angel sagihte kiang ah tangtawn tangtawn a hing Pathian hehna a dim dangka-eng belhbu sagihte apia hi.
english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

paite: Huchi in Pathian thupina athilhihtheihna a kipan meikhu in tempul hihdim in a-om hi; angel sagihte gawtna sagihte atunkim masiah asung ah kuamah alut theita kei uhi.
english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
